waiting.EDIT: Waiting for procurement to check it and send it for approval
waiting.APPROVER_UNKNOWN: Waiting for the approver of the DOA
waiting.SEND: Waiting for procurement to send it to the supplier
waiting.SEND_BOUNCED: The e-mail to the supplier bounced; waiting for procurement to send it again
waiting.DELIVERY: Waiting for the supplier to deliver
waiting.REST: Waiting for the rest of the goods
waiting.CLOSE: Received in full; waiting for the invoice and the closing

list.title: Purchase orders (PO)
list.intro: Every purchase order of the organization, the ones changed last at the top, each with whom it waits for.
list.forbidden: This page is for procurement. If you think you should open it, contact your organization's administrator.
list.search: Search a PO number or a supplier
list.searchHint: Type part of a number such as 00012, or of a supplier's name or code
list.clear: Clear the search and the filter
list.limited: Showing the {shown} changed last. Search by number or filter by status to find the others.
list.emptyHint: Purchase orders come from approved requests put together in the procurement pool.
list.noMatch: No purchase order matches the search
list.noMatchHint: Change the search or the status, or clear them to see every purchase order.

detail.notFound: This purchase order was not found
detail.notYours: You may not see this purchase order
detail.notYoursHint: Purchase orders open for procurement, finance, executives, auditors, the requesters of their requests and their approvers. If you think you should open it, contact your administrator.
detail.pdfDraft: Preview the PDF of the draft
detail.viewOnly: You can only look at this purchase order. Editing, sending and cancelling are procurement's work.
detail.rejectedState: The approver rejected this purchase order. Its request lines are back in the procurement pool.
detail.returnedNote: The approver returned it for changes; the reason is on the timeline. Change it, then send it for approval again.

disposition.RETURN_TO_POOL: the request lines went back to the procurement pool
disposition.CANCEL_REQUEST_LINES: the quantity was cancelled on the requests too

detail.routeNotYet: The approval route is worked out when the PO is sent for approval, then shows here with why

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.draftNote: Computed from the draft's prices and quantities at today's VAT rate, and computed again when the PO is sent for approval.
amounts.fixedNote: The amounts and the VAT were computed when the PO was sent for approval.
amounts.draftNoteStored: No VAT rate covers today: this VAT was computed when the draft was made. The PO can be sent for approval once an administrator adds today's rate.

lines.title: Lines
lines.label: Lines of the purchase order
lines.pricesTitle: Prices paid before for this item
lines.pricesNone: Not bought before on an approved PO
lines.priceAlert: The new price is more than {pct}% above the last one
lines.priceOk: The new price is not more than {pct}% above the last one

what.RESENT: PO sent to the supplier again
what.BOUNCED: The e-mail to the supplier bounced
what.WAIT_EDIT: Waiting for procurement to check it and send it for approval
what.WAIT_SEND: Waiting to be sent to the supplier
what.WAIT_DELIVERY: Waiting for the supplier to deliver and the receiver to record it
what.WAIT_CLOSE: Waiting for the invoice and the closing

actions.title: What you can do now
actions.nothing: Nothing is left to do on this purchase order.

edit.title: Edit the draft
edit.maxHint: At most {max} {uom}, what the request still has left; what is not ordered waits in the pool with the same supplier
edit.mergedHint: This line orders several request lines, so its quantity cannot change
edit.remove: Take this line off, back to the procurement pool
edit.removeHint: The request line goes back to the pool with its supplier. A draft keeps at least one line.
edit.removed: Line {no} taken off; its request line is back in the procurement pool with the same supplier
edit.termsTitle: Terms and note to the supplier
edit.termHint: Leave empty when there is none; 0 means cash on delivery; at most {max, number} days
edit.noteHint: The supplier reads it on the PDF of the purchase order
edit.savedLine: Line {no} saved; the amounts were computed again
edit.badPrice: Type the price as a number with at most 2 decimals, such as 1,500.00
edit.badQuantity: Type a quantity above 0 with at most 4 decimals
edit.badDays: Type the days as a whole number from 0 to {max, number}
edit.allRemoved: A draft keeps at least one line, and a whole draft cannot be thrown away yet. A draft that was not sent for approval orders nothing and reserves no more budget: leave it, and tell your organization's administrator.

submit.title: Send for approval
submit.extraReserve: The PO costs more than its requests reserved: sending it reserves {amount} baht more. If the budget is short it cannot be sent.
submit.noExtra: The PO costs no more than its requests reserved; nothing more is reserved.
submit.hint: Once sent, the PO gets its number and waits for the approver of the DOA. Procurement can change it again only if the approver returns it.
submit.supplierInactive: This supplier is inactive, so the PO cannot be sent for approval. Activate the supplier in the supplier register first, then come back to send it.

blocked.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No DOA covers purchase orders, so it cannot be sent for approval. Contact your organization's administrator.
blocked.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: The approver of the DOA was not found, so it cannot be sent for approval. Ask your organization's administrator to check the position holders.
blocked.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: Every approver of the DOA is involved in this document, so it cannot be sent for approval. Contact your organization's administrator.
blocked.TAX_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No VAT rate covers today, so it cannot be sent for approval. Contact your administrator.
blocked.NO_LINES: This draft has no lines, so it cannot be sent for approval.
blocked.SOD_VIOLATION: The approver of the DOA is involved in this purchase order (made or sent it, or asked for one of its source requests), and this DOA version does not pass it to a higher authority, so it cannot be sent for approval. Ask your organization's administrator to check the DOA.
blocked.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: More than one rule of the DOA applies to this purchase order, so it cannot be sent for approval. Ask your organization's administrator to correct the DOA.
blocked.ZERO_AMOUNT: The draft totals 0.00 baht. Enter the unit prices under “Edit the draft”, then send it for approval.
blocked.other: The DOA finds no approver for this purchase order, so it cannot be sent for approval. Contact your organization's administrator.

send.title: Send the PO to the supplier
send.to: By e-mail to {email} with the PDF. The supplier can reply to you directly.
send.noEmail: This supplier has no e-mail address in the register yet. Add it in the supplier register first, then come back to send.
send.button: Send the PO to the supplier
send.confirmText: Send {number} by e-mail to {email}. Once sent it cannot be called back.
send.sent: The PO was sent to the supplier
send.bounced: The e-mail to the supplier bounced (code {code}). The PO is still approved. Check the supplier's e-mail in the register, then send it again with a reason.
send.bounceState: The e-mail sent {time} bounced (code {code}). The PO is still approved. Check the supplier's e-mail in the register, then send it again with a reason.

resend.title: Send the PO again
resend.hint: For example the supplier asked for it again, or the last e-mail bounced. The supplier gets the latest PDF, marked as sent again.
resend.reasonHint: Kept on the timeline of the purchase order
resend.resent: The PO was sent to the supplier again

cancel.title: Cancel the PO
cancel.hint: Possible before any goods are received. Everything the PO holds goes back. Choose what happens to the request lines.
cancel.choice: The request lines of this PO
cancel.RETURN_TO_POOL_HINT: The lines go back to the pool to be ordered again, and the budget is reserved for the requests again
cancel.CANCEL_REQUEST_LINES: Cancel this quantity on the requests too
cancel.CANCEL_REQUEST_LINES_HINT: They will not be ordered; the budget goes back to the budget line and requests with nothing left to order are completed
cancel.reasonHint: Requesters and auditors read it on the timeline
cancel.confirmTick: I checked, and I understand a cancelled PO cannot be brought back

close.title: Close the PO
close.hint: Everything came. Closing gives back what is held beyond what was received; what was received and not yet invoiced stays held for the invoice.
close.confirmTick: I understand a closed PO cannot be opened again
close.needsShortfall: Some lines did not come in full. It closes once they come; if the rest will not come, ask to close the purchase order short on its receiving page, and close it once that is approved.

actions.confirmMissing: Tick to confirm first, because this cannot be undone
actions.reasonMissing: Type a reason of at least 3 characters
actions.nothingWhileApproval: The purchase order waits for its approver; there is nothing to do meanwhile

errors.STATE: This purchase order changed status already. Reload the page to see where it is now.
errors.GR_POSTED: Goods were received on this purchase order already, so the PO cannot be cancelled. If what is still to come will not come, ask to close the purchase order short on its receiving page.
errors.SHORT_NOT_APPROVED: Some lines did not come in full. It closes once they come; if the rest will not come, ask to close the purchase order short on its receiving page, and close it once that is approved.
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone else changed this draft while you had it open. Reload the page and edit it again.
errors.NO_CHANGE: Nothing changed. Change a price, a quantity, the terms or the note before saving.
errors.QUANTITY_OVER_REQUEST: More than the request has left ({left} left). Lower the quantity and save again.
errors.MERGED_LINE: A line that orders several request lines cannot change its quantity, only its price. To order another quantity, take this line off, back to the procurement pool, then press “Make draft POs now” in the pool: the new draft has one line per request line, so its quantities can change.
errors.NO_LINES: A draft keeps at least one line
errors.LINE: Some lines are no longer on this draft. Reload the page.
errors.SUPPLIER_INACTIVE: This supplier is inactive, so the PO cannot be sent for approval. Activate the supplier in the supplier register first, then come back to send it.
errors.NO_SOURCE_REQUEST: Every line must come from an approved request, but some lines of this draft have no source request (under “Lines” they show no “From request”), so it cannot be sent for approval. Take those lines off under “Edit the draft”, then send it for approval again.
errors.EMAIL_MISSING: This supplier has no e-mail address in the register. Add one, then send again.
errors.REASON: Type a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: The budget line does not have enough for what the PO costs above its requests, so it cannot be sent for approval yet. Lower the price or quantity to what the requests reserved, or ask the budget administrator for more budget.
errors.BUDGET_LINE_CLOSED: The budget line of a request is closed or frozen. Contact the budget administrator.
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No DOA covers purchase orders. Contact your organization's administrator.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: The approver of the DOA was not found. Ask your organization's administrator to check the position holders.
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: Every approver of the DOA is involved in this document. Contact your organization's administrator.
errors.TAX_RATE: No VAT rate covers today. Contact your administrator.
errors.EMAIL_SERVICE: The e-mail service could not be reached, so the PO was not sent. Try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this to a purchase order; it is procurement's work.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This purchase order was not found. Reload the page.
errors.BUSY: Someone is working on this purchase order right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different data. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try once more.
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved because of a system error (reference {requestId}). Try again, or tell your administrator this reference.
errors.FAILED: Not saved. Try again, or contact your administrator.
errors.PAYMENT_DAYS: The credit days must be a whole number from 0 to {max, number}. Correct it and save again.
errors.NOTE: The note to the supplier is longer than {noteMax, number} characters. Shorten it and save again.
errors.LINES: A price or a quantity is not valid: prices take at most 2 decimals and quantities at most 4. Correct them and save again.
errors.DISPOSITION: Choose what happens to the request lines of this PO, then cancel it again.
errors.BUDGET_SHORTFALL: The budget line does not have enough for what the PO costs above its requests ({shortfall} baht short). Lower the price or quantity, or ask the budget administrator for more budget.
errors.CANCEL_BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: The budget line does not have enough to reserve for the requests again, so the lines cannot go back to the pool. Choose to cancel this quantity on the requests instead, or contact the budget administrator.
errors.CANCEL_BUDGET_SHORTFALL: The budget line does not have enough to reserve for the requests again ({shortfall} baht short), so the lines cannot go back to the pool. Choose to cancel this quantity on the requests instead, or contact the budget administrator.

state.CLOSED: PO closed; what was not used went back

lineStatus.CLOSED: The budget line is closed and takes no new reservation

budget.note: These are this PO's own amounts, not what is left on the budget line. Budget counts amounts before VAT.
budget.none: This PO charges no budget line yet

requests.heading: Source requests and attachments
requests.label: Source requests of the purchase order
requests.title: {number} · {title}
requests.closed: You may not open this request, so its attachments are not shown
